data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that hides content with a blur/particle spoiler animation until tapped.
data.what_it_does: It overlays a configurable blur, particle, or wave effect over any widget or text. Users can reveal the hidden content by tapping, with optional gesture control and custom mask shapes.
use_when: You need to hide sensitive text or images in a UI
You want a Telegram‑style spoiler reveal effect
You require custom particle or wave animations for the reveal
avoid_when: Static content where a simple opacity change suffices
Performance‑critical lists with many items where heavy particle rendering may impact FPS
strengths: Highly configurable particle and wave effects
Supports custom mask paths and multiple platforms
Easy to integrate with existing widgets
weaknesses: Potential performance cost on low‑end devices
Limited to visual hiding; no built‑in content protection

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a lightweight shimmering placeholder effect without particle or wave complexity
